product_overview: Botrix Dashboard is a comprehensive chatbot management platform that leverages AI technologies to enable users to create, customize, and manage multiple chatbots. It features real-time chat, voice integration, advanced analytics, and team collaboration capabilities, all wrapped in a responsive, easy-to-use interface.
core_goals: Enable users to create, configure, and manage AI-powered chatbots seamlessly.
Provide real-time conversational capabilities with robust message processing.
Integrate advanced voice features including text-to-speech and speech-to-text.
Offer deep analytics dashboards to track bot performance and user engagement.
Facilitate team collaboration and user management within the platform.
Support embeddable chat widgets easily integrated into external websites.
Ensure secure and flexible authentication and user account management.
Support file uploads and media integration for enhanced chatbot interaction.
Enable webhook integrations with external AI services and APIs.
key_features: Complete authentication system with Google OAuth, email/password login, email verification, password reset.
Bot management system with features to create, edit, configure, test, and analyze bots, including a visual bot flow builder.
Real-time chat system powered by Socket.IO supporting conversation and message management.
Voice integration utilizing Google Cloud APIs for text-to-speech and speech-to-text functionalities.
Image and file upload system integrated with Cloudinary and local storage fallbacks.
Comprehensive analytics dashboard providing metrics on bot usage and engagement.
Embeddable, customizable chat widgets that can be easily added to any website.
Team and user management functionalities allowing collaboration and profile/account settings management.
Webhook support for extending bot capabilities through external AI services and automation.
Reusable UI components built with Radix UI and styled with Tailwind CSS for consistent design.
user_flow_summary: User signs up or logs in via email/password or Google OAuth and completes email verification if required.
User accesses the dashboard to create a new chatbot or manage existing bots through lists and detailed views.
User utilizes the bot builder interface to visually design and configure chatbot flows and settings.
User tests bots using provided test functionality and monitors conversations in real-time.
User uploads images or files to be used within bots or chat conversations, leveraging Cloudinary or local storage.
User integrates voice features by selecting and previewing available voices, and using text-to-speech or speech-to-text capabilities during chat.
User views and analyzes bot performance metrics through the analytics dashboard to optimize interactions.
User embeds chat widgets into external websites by copying and configuring script tags with customization options.
User manages team members and account settings, inviting collaborators and setting roles.
User configures webhook integrations to connect chatbots with external AI services or automation workflows.
validation_criteria: Authentication workflows are secure, supporting Google OAuth and email/password methods with email verification and password reset functioning correctly.
Bots can be created, updated, deleted, and managed without errors, with the visual builder showing correct flow configurations.
Real-time chat functionality is performant and reliable using Socket.IO, with messages properly sent, received, and persisted.
Voice features accurately convert text-to-speech and speech-to-text using Google Cloud APIs, with support detection working correctly.
File uploads handle images and media correctly, integrating with Cloudinary in production and storing files locally in development.
Analytics dashboard displays accurate, up-to-date metrics on bot usage and user engagement.
Chat widgets embed correctly in external sites with customizable options and function seamlessly.
User and team management features correctly handle profiles, settings, and team invitations with appropriate permissions.
Webhook integrations trigger and authenticate properly allowing secure communication with external AI and automation services.
UI components render consistently across supported browsers and devices, adhering to design and accessibility standards.
